chapters.label: Seven minutes left, live
chapters.text: July twenty twenty-four, Euro last sixteen. France and Belgium, nil-nil, seven minutes left. Doku and Lukaku break down the left, and Kevin De Bruyne hits a low, rasping shot!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Mike Maignan pushes off hard with the foot nearest the ball, and flies low across his goal.

chapters.label: Full stretch
chapters.text: From the goal line: at full stretch, his glove pushes the ball away. Two minutes later, France score!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: What a flying save! Your turn: push off hard with the foot nearest the ball, and you will dive further.
